name: @local/dsh-danbooru-tools
description: DSH bundle (not a standalone program) — AI-made, read-only, image-only Danbooru tools. Default (core) preset registers the 11 most-used tools: post/tag search, tag details, related tags, year-favorites artist ranking, tag-based style matching, similar artists, image-to-artist search, pixel-similarity style matching (with per-artist closest-year annotation), credentials. toolPreset="full" (or DANBOORU_TOOL_PRESET=full) adds the four rarely used extras: weighted Hot/rising artist ranking, part specialists, multi-scheme consensus and single-post lookup. NAI prompt strings emit weight-1 tags bare (no :: wrapper). Image-to-artist keeps a leader board per dimension, so a one-aspect specialist still reaches the artist string (or the try_next queue) instead of being cut by the whole-image ranking.
